description: A horizontal capsule contains a check mark on the left and a cross on the right, separated by a diagonal divider. The two opposing marks form one balanced privacy-choice symbol.
A hand enters from the upper right and grips the top of an upright sheet between its fingers. Three horizontal text lines sit beneath the grip inside the rectangular document.
A flat-topped hat with sloping sides and a long horizontal brim sits above round spectacles. Two circular lenses join through a small curved bridge, forming a symmetrical disguise without a face.
A circular globe is divided by a straight central vertical line and three horizontal bands. The middle band crosses the widest part, while the upper and lower bands meet the curved perimeter.
A browser window, a small upright phone, and a landscape screen overlap in a compact group. A hand rises from the lower right with its index finger touching the front screen.
A small upright phone overlaps the upper-right corner of a larger browser window. Each device has a horizontal structural divider, and the larger window outline opens where the phone covers it.
Two tall rounded screens stand side by side above a shallow laptop base. A horizontal connection joins them across the middle, and short vertical supports connect their lower edges to the base.
A tablet and a narrower phone overlap the open display of a laptop. The phone has a small lower control, while the laptop base spreads beneath the group with a central notch.
A desktop monitor on a short pedestal has a face with crossed eyes and a horizontal mouth with its tongue sticking out. A lower bezel separates the face from the stand.
A rectangular server tilts diagonally upward to the right, with two small indicator marks on its face. Two curved wings attach to its upper edge and extend behind it with scalloped inner contours.
Two long capsule-shaped server units sit directly above one another, each with a circular indicator and a horizontal slot. Four short vertical motion strokes hang beneath the lower unit.
An upright rounded browser window has a narrow header with a short horizontal mark. Two text lines of unequal length sit below the header divider in the otherwise open page.
A rounded rectangular browser window has a horizontal toolbar divider near the top. Three small controls sit together at the upper left, leaving the large content area beneath them empty.
A rounded rectangular browser window has a horizontal toolbar divider near the top. Three small controls sit together at the upper left, leaving the large content area beneath them empty.
A rounded rectangular browser window has a horizontal toolbar divider near the top. Three small controls sit together at the upper left, leaving the large content area beneath them empty.
A wide horizontal field overlaps the top of a narrower dropdown panel. Three short option lines run down the panel, with an upward chevron and a downward chevron aligned along its right side.
A horizontal field overlaps the upper-left portion of a taller options panel. A check mark occupies the exposed upper-right area, and two horizontal option lines sit below the field.
A rectangular list has two horizontal item lines on its left and a narrow control column on its right. Upward and downward chevrons occupy opposite ends of that divided column.
A long horizontal form field has rounded corners and a vertical divider near its right end. A check mark sits inside the small right-hand compartment, while the larger left compartment remains blank.
A spider web radiates from a central junction to eight outer points. Concave curved strands join neighbouring tips around the perimeter, making an evenly spread outline with pointed corners.
An upright webpage displays the word LIVE across its top and two rows of short text marks below. A horizontal footer band runs along the bottom with a small compartment at the right.
